title: Recipe box
audience: For cooks whose recipes live in screenshots, tabs and someone else's blog.
description: A recipe box your AI files for you: paste a recipe and it becomes a clean sub-note with ingredients as a checklist.
tagline: Your recipes, cleaned up and filed.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Recipe box". When I paste a recipe, clean it up: a title, servings and time on one line, the ingredients as a checklist, and short numbered steps, without the life story. Save it as a sub-note with create, in the note's own folder ("Recipes/Recipe box/<recipe title>.md"), then read the note with fetch and move its link line under "Weeknight", "Weekend" or "Baking" with edit, whichever fits. Recipes I want to try later go under "Want to try" as a bullet. When I ask what to cook, look through the box with search.

Lemon chicken with rice

Serves 4, 35 minutes.

- [ ] 8 chicken thighs
- [ ] 2 lemons
- [ ] 300 g rice

1. Brown the chicken.
2. Add the rice, lemon and water. Simmer 20 minutes.
